execution: CPU scalar toy only; no robot, teacher policy, public diagnostic learning or cloudcalls
hypothesis: A small outcome model can learn where to replace a fixed progressing policy with a persistent correction, without a supplied geometric trigger, while preserving its useful behavior elsewhere.
environment: 50steps;initialposition uniform1..2, speed uniform.02..08;baseaction=-speed; correctionaction0holdsposition. Terminal reward1iffpositionwithin.2ofunknown-to-learner target0. Existing base action and zero-action prior are given assistance, explicitly not a fromscratchalgorithm.
training: 2048completeepisodes per seed; randomdecisiontime uniform0..49 and balanced randomtreatment continuebase or holdforever. Observeonly2statecoordinates(position,speed), treatment and finalbinaryoutcome. No oracle actions or target labels.
models: Two separately fitted logistic outcome models on generic degree2polynomial state features, normalized fromtrainingonly. L2.001,LBFGSmax100, fixedinit. Gate requires predictedholdsuccess>=.9 and predictedhold-basegain>=.1. It latches, without clock or target access.
calibration: 512freshfullclosedloopepisodes per seed. Gate admitted onlyif95%Wilsonlowerbound finalsuccess>=.8. This is rolloutcalibration, not randomstateclassificationaccuracy. Calibrationcostcounted; no thresholdtuning.
test: 16384newinitialconditions per seed; base, randomswitch, admittedlearnedswitch and oracleupperbound; eachcontroller50actualtoy steps. Oracleupperbound iscomparisononly, notdata ortraininginput.
screen: All3seeds: learnedfinalsuccess-base>=.40; learnedfinalsuccesswithin.05oforacle; retain>=99%ofbase-successful episodes. Shuffledwholetrainingoutcomes negativecontrolmustfailadmission. Scope onlythisassistedtoy; no robottraining fromsuccess.
counting: Perseed2048training+512learnedcalibration+512shuffledcalibration+4*16384testepisodes. Everyepisode50toytransitions. Count allfitclosures/backwards andwalltime. No robot efficiency inference.
